expressions.title: The Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973
expressions.title_basis: p1 block 1997004 prints 'ORDINANCE No. XVI OF 1973'; s.1 names it; ss.1-6 complete. The p1 head is a fragment of an earlier Ordinance, and the untitled Presidential Order of 14 August 1973 that follows on p3 (declaring the right to move a court for the enforcement of certain Fundamental Rights suspended) prints no short title, so it is set aside as apparatus rather than given an invented name (owner policy q1 'split'; INV-1).
